item.title: [IGNITE-7890] Node start with corrupted pds hangs indefinitely.
item.description: Starting node with corrupted PDS + WAL leads to cluster-wide hang-up.
item.summary: Node start with corrupted pds hangs indefinitely.

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.
